# vvm Provider

Terraform provider for the IBM Cloud VPC Virtualization Manager (VVM). Manages VMs, guest networks, datastores, backup policies and protection groups via the VVM REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    vvm = {
      source = "neil1taylor/vvm"
    }
  }
}

provider "vvm" {
  # Or set VVM_API_URL and VVM_API_TOKEN in the environment.
  api_url   = var.vvm_api_url
  api_token = var.vvm_api_token
}

variable "vvm_api_url" { type = string }

variable "vvm_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) VVM API bearer token. Falls back to `VVM_API_TOKEN`. Set `IBMCLOUD_API_KEY` for automatic IAM token exchange (not yet implemented in the provider; use an explicit token for now).
- `api_url` (String) VVM API base URL (e.g. `https://vvm-api.example.ibm.com`). Falls back to the `VVM_API_URL` environment variable.
